camel_example: aliyun csas ListUserDevices --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --SortBy UpdateTime --SnBios 5CG0030000 --IaStatuses.1 Disabled --Department '测试部' --DeviceGroupId 'device-group-5191cf830a5e0000' --PaStatuses.1 Enabled --AppVersions.1 '4.5.0' --Workshop '测试办公区' --DlpStatuses.1 Enabled --InnerIp '192.168.XX.XX' --SharingStatus true --Hostname 'win10-64bit' --AppStatuses.1 Online --DeviceTags.1 '36efa42d-2c32-c4dc-e3fc-8541e33a0000' --SaseUserId su_e8f218fb171edd167c2ad917d21f53148bdefc510ca1f3c3cc0249d3643d0000 --AutoLoginStatuses.1 'example-string' --DeviceStatuses.1 Online --Mac '00:16:XX:XX:7c:46' --DeviceBelong Company --CurrentPage 1 --Username '王先生' --SnSystem KVN9C90000 --NacStatuses.1 Unprovisioned --DeviceTypes.1 Windows --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the list of user endpoint devices under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下用户终端设备列表
kebab_example: aliyun csas list-user-devices --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --username '王先生' --sase-user-id su_e8f218fb171edd167c2ad917d21f53148bdefc510ca1f3c3cc0249d3643d0000 --department '测试部' --hostname win10-64bit --device-belong Company --mac 00:16:XX:XX:7c:46 --sharing-status true --device-statuses Online --app-statuses Online --pa-statuses Enabled --ia-statuses Disabled --dlp-statuses Enabled --nac-statuses Unprovisioned --auto-login-statuses example-string --device-types Windows --device-tags 36efa42d-2c32-c4dc-e3fc-8541e33a0000 --sort-by UpdateTime --inner-ip 192.168.XX.XX --app-versions 4.5.0 --workshop '测试办公区' --device-group-id device-group-5191cf830a5e0000 --sn-system KVN9C90000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserDevices

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Settings: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值范围：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The username. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters and uppercase and lowercase letters. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), asterisks (*), at signs (@), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 用户名。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）、星号（*）、at（@）和空格
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The user ID. You can obtain this value from the following operations:
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user endpoint device.
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user endpoint devices
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID。取值来源：
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情。
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备
parameters.name: sase_user_id

parameters.help_en: The department to which the user belongs. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters and uppercase and lowercase letters. It can contain digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 用户所属部门。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、分隔号（/）、at（@）和空格
parameters.name: department

parameters.help_en: The name of the endpoint device. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters and uppercase and lowercase letters. It can contain digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces. If you enter only an underscore (), endpoint devices whose names contain 4-byte UTF-8 characters are also queried
parameters.help_zh: 终端设备名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）、短划线（-）、下划线（\）、分隔号（/）、at（@）和空格。单独输入下划线（\）将额外查询所有名称中带4字节utf-8字符的终端设备
parameters.name: hostname

parameters.help_zh:
